summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a Form 6-K containing its consolidated summary report for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, under Japanese GAAP. The filing discloses financial results, dividends, and an earnings target; it does not describe any special-situations transaction such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The report is a routine periodic financial update, not an event-driven corporate action. Therefore, this filing does not constitute a special situation under the defined categories.
